name: Cliamp Visualizer
author: bol
description: Real-time spectrum visualizer bar and media controls for cliamp

barWidget.description: Adaptive audio visualizer and controls for cliamp

schema.label: Stream FPS (10-30)
schema.description: Frame rate for audio spectrum streaming

schema.label: Show Track Title
schema.description: Display track title next to the visualizer

schema.label: Max Title Length
schema.description: Maximum characters of track title to display before truncating

schema.label: Adaptive Visualizer Colors
schema.description: Use visualizer-specific thematic accent colors (e.g. green for Matrix, pink for Sakura)

schema.label: Auto-hide when cliamp is closed
schema.description: Hide the widget from the bar when cliamp is not running

schema.label: Display Mode (1: Both, 2: Vis only, 3: Playback only)
schema.description: Initial display mode: 1 for Playback + Visualizer, 2 for Visualizer only, 3 for Playback only
